patterns.cli_argument_pattern: All CLI flags are added to argparse.ArgumentParser in cli/main.py with proper help text and examples
patterns.exit_code_pattern: Use sys.exit() with specific codes - currently using 0 (success), 1 (error), 130 (Ctrl+C)
patterns.json_output_pattern: JSON output already used in workspace_commands.py: print(json.dumps(result))
patterns.env_var_pattern: Environment variables read via os.getenv() in utils.py - e.g., DEFAULT_BRANCH, AUTO_BUILD_MODEL
patterns.artifact_pattern: Status and build data tracked in ui/status.py with BuildState enum and StatusManager

existing_implementations.cli_structure: CLI entry point is apps/backend/run.py which imports cli.main. argparse used for argument parsing in cli/main.py
existing_implementations.exit_codes: Current exit codes: 0 (success), 1 (various errors), 130 (KeyboardInterrupt). No specific codes for build/QA failure
existing_implementations.json_output: JSON output pattern exists in workspace_commands.py for --merge-preview and --create-pr commands
existing_implementations.build_states: BuildState enum in ui/status.py: IDLE, PLANNING, BUILDING, QA, COMPLETE, PAUSED, ERROR
existing_implementations.github_actions: Existing CI workflow: .github/workflows/ci.yml with cross-platform testing (Linux, Windows, macOS)
